current_evidence: Every blackburn.gov.uk page, including the workbook PDF and the 'Apply for planning permission' page, refused automated fetching (robots_disallowed), so I could not confirm which file the council page links to now. No newer upload turned up in searches. The newest list text I could read is the council's committee paper 'Final Draft version - Validation Checklist January 2024' (democracy.blackburn.gov.uk s22812), whose L-numbered items match Grokbot's extracts; that checklist text carries no adoption date. planning.data.gov.uk entity 20013 still points to an older May 2021 file.

issues.detail: Householder is marked '(none) ... national requirements only', but the list applies several local requirements to householder schemes: Heritage Statement (L18) for alterations to any building in a Conservation Area, Tree/Arboricultural Survey (L5) for works affecting trees, TPO trees or trees in a Conservation Area, Ecological Survey/Protected Species Proforma (L6) for roof works, demolition or tree/hedgerow removal, Flood Risk Assessment (L15) in Flood Zones 2/3 (dormers excluded, standing advice for minor extensions), Refuse storage (L19) where an extension blocks rear access, and Site Plans (N7) for householder extensions that change parking or sit close to neighbours' habitable-room windows.
issues.evidence: N7 'ARE ALWAYS required for ... Householder extensions which displace or alter parking ... close to neighbouring properties'; L18 'Alteration or demolition of any building in a Conservation Area' (householders included); L26 Coal Mining is the only item that expressly excludes householder.

issues.detail: Every application type except Full planning is '(none)', even where the list names that type. Listed building consent: N11 Design & Access Statement, L4 Structural Survey (where structural alteration or demolition is proposed or asked for at pre-app) and L18 Heritage Statement. Outline: N11 DAS for major outline applications, plus the major-development items. Advertisement consent: N7 site plan for adverts not fixed to a building, and N8/N9 advert position and elevation details. Demolition in a conservation area: L4 Demolition/Method Statement, L18 Heritage Statement and L6 ecology for demolition of any building. Prior approval: L4 for prior notification of demolition.
issues.evidence: N11 'Required for: Major development (full and outline) ... Listed Building Consent applications'; L4 'Demolition of relevant buildings in conservation areas', 'Prior notification for demolition'.

issues.detail: Grokbot tagged 30 of its 37 Full planning rows 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Many of these items are not limited to full applications. For example, Heritage Statement, Tree Survey and Ecology apply to householder, LBC and demolition cases too, and the Fire Statement and Planning Statement thresholds are size-based, so they also cover outline schemes. Grokbot also lists the list's national 'N' items (N7 Site plan, N8/N9 plans and elevations, N10 sections, N11 DAS, N12 EIA) as if they were local items, without saying so.
issues.evidence: The checklist splits 'NATIONAL REQUIREMENTS' (N1-N14) from 'LOCAL REQUIREMENTS' (L1-L40) and sets triggers by development type or threshold, not by application type.

issues.detail: Retail Impact Assessment (Town Centre Uses) (L14) is missing. It applies to town centre uses over 280 sqm within 500m of a district/local centre or parade, over 500 sqm in the Darwen urban area (south of the M65), or over 1,000 sqm in the Blackburn urban area (north of the M65), or when asked for at pre-application.
issues.evidence: L14 Retail Impact Assessment, based on Local Plan Part 2 Policy 29 thresholds of 280 / 500 / 1,000 sqm.

issues.detail: Refuse Storage / Recycling Details (L19) is missing. It applies to all new developments, amendments, extensions to non-residential property and extensions that block rear access, and is normally shown on the proposed site plan.
issues.evidence: L19 Refuse Storage / Recycling Details: 'All new developments ... extensions blocking rear access'.

issues.detail: Vacant Building Credit Statement (L10) is missing. It is needed where a reduced affordable housing contribution is sought through Vacant Building Credit, with evidence of vacancy, evidence the use has not been abandoned, and existing vs proposed GIFA (RICS definition).
issues.evidence: L10 Vacant Building Credit Statement.

issues.detail: Open Space Proposals (L11) is missing as a requirement in its own right. It is needed when asked for at pre-application. Grokbot's 'Open space / play space assessment' row actually quotes the separate Playing Field Land / Sport England checklist (L30/L32).
issues.evidence: L11 Open Space Proposals 'When requested as part of the pre-application process'; L32 'applications affecting playing field land ... Sport England recommends'.

issues.detail: Met Office Assessment (L29) is missing. It applies to wind turbine applications within the 20km consultation zone of the Hameldon Hill radar, or above the consultation map height limits, and needs a proforma.
issues.evidence: L29 Met Office Assessment: wind turbines within 20km of Hameldon Hill radar.

issues.detail: Public Water Supply Risk Assessment (L40) is missing. It applies where development is on catchment land for public water supply (Policy DM12) or when asked for at pre-application.
issues.evidence: L40 Public Water Supply Risk Assessment: 'catchment land for public water supply (Policy DM12)'.

issues.detail: Natural Capital Assessment (L39) is missing. It is needed when asked for at pre-application or where the nature or scale of the proposal merits it.
issues.evidence: L39 Natural Capital Assessment (detail to follow in the Natural Environment SPD).

issues.detail: Climate Impact Framework (L37) is missing. It is required for major residential and major commercial schemes, and possibly minor residential, once the SPD is adopted and the form is available.
issues.evidence: L37 Climate Impact Framework: 'Major residential; Major commercial; Minor residential (subject to consultation)'.

issues.detail: The Drainage Strategy / SuDS trigger is pro-forma boilerplate ('This Pro-forma is endorsed by the North West Regional Flood and Coastal Committee ... Version 3: August 2020'), not the trigger. The Drainage Scheme (L16) thresholds are residential 10+ units (or over 0.5ha where units are unspecified), retail/commercial/industrial over 1,000 sqm or sites over 1ha, other uses on sites over 1ha, change of use over 1,000 sqm GFA, and discharge to the canal. N13 SuDS plans apply to all major development.
issues.evidence: L16 Drainage Scheme thresholds; N13 SuDS Plans 'All major developments'.

issues.detail: The Transport Assessment / Transport Statement row quotes the Travel Plan (L13) trigger, which is identical to the Travel Plan row. The real L12 trigger is all major development, with guide thresholds of 50+ dwellings or more than 1,000 sqm of new floor space, or when asked for at pre-application.
issues.evidence: L12 Transport Statement / Transport Assessment: 'All major development ... 50+ dwellings ... floor space over 1,000 sqm'.

issues.detail: The Fire Statement trigger is unrelated text (a GOV.UK template link plus the L1 'APPLICATIONS WILL BE MADE INVALID' banner and pre-application text). The actual trigger is buildings with two or more dwellings or educational accommodation that are 18m+ high or 7+ storeys.
issues.evidence: N14 / L34 Fire Statement: 'two or more dwellings or educational accommodation ... 18 metres ... seven or more storeys'.

issues.detail: Many triggers keep only the first bullet, 'When requested as part of the pre-application process', and drop the objective triggers that follow. Flood Risk Assessment (L15) omits all development in Flood Zones 2/3 and sites over 1ha in Flood Zone 1. Crime Impact Statement (L25) omits 25+ dwellings, HMOs, licensed premises, student accommodation and similar. Noise (L21) omits wind turbines and noise-generating uses near homes. Lighting (L24) omits effects on biodiversity or neighbours. Contaminated Land (L20) omits known or suspected contamination and vulnerable uses. Archaeology (L17) omits 'all development affecting a known archaeological site'.
issues.evidence: L15 'All development in Flood Zones 2 and 3 ... over 1ha in Flood Zone 1'; L25 'Residential 25+ dwellings'.

issues.detail: Several triggers are cut off or run into the next item. Design and Access Statement ends at 'Required for' and omits major, conservation area (1+ dwellings or 100 sqm+) and LBC. Landscaping is '9 L7 Landscaping proposals Required'. The Agricultural dwelling trigger runs into 'L28 Energy Statement Required: For major development'. Telecoms runs into the BNG text. The Arboricultural trigger starts with the L4 text 'Demolition of relevant buildings in conservation areas'. The SCI trigger is cut off mid-threshold.
issues.evidence: N11 'Major development (full and outline); development in a Conservation Area ... one or more dwellings or a building of 100 sq m or more; Listed Building Consent'.

issues.detail: The Coal Mining Risk Assessment trigger is only 'Coal Mining Risk Assessment (IF REQUIRED) 16.'. The source applies L26 to development (except householder) that disturbs the ground in a Coal Authority high-risk area, or when asked for at pre-application.
issues.evidence: L26 Coal Mining Risk Assessment: development 'except householder' in a high-risk area.

issues.detail: The Health Impact Assessment trigger leaves out the numeric thresholds: residential 100+ units, non-residential 10,000 sqm+, and other developments with significant health impacts (Appendix C screening toolkit).
issues.evidence: L31 Health Impact Assessment: 'residential 100+ units; non-residential 10,000 m2+'.

issues.detail: The Viability Assessment trigger is a fragment ('being sought, a Viability Appraisal must be submitted as described above'). L9 says a viability appraisal is needed where the applicant considers 20% affordable housing, or other S106 requirements, unviable. It follows the HCA Development Appraisal Tool and is needed for determination but not for validation.
issues.evidence: L9 Affordable Housing / Viability Report: 'not needed to validate, but needed to determine'.

issues.detail: The 'Minerals / Waste specific statements (county matters)' label and trigger are misleading. L33 requires a mineral resource assessment for any development within a Mineral Safeguarding Area (Policy M2), not county-matter minerals or waste applications, and the quoted trigger is only a map-link fragment.
issues.evidence: L33 Mineral Safeguarding Areas: 'Sites within a Mineral Safeguarding Area (Policy M2)'.

issues.detail: Several rows repeat the same source text under different labels. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' uses the L4 Structural Survey barn-conversion trigger, the same as the Structural Survey row; the list has no listed-building schedule-of-works item. 'Roof plan' and 'Floor plans / Elevations' both quote N9. Transport Assessment and Travel Plan share the L13 text.
issues.evidence: Both rows quote 'Structural surveys are required for: The conversion of barns or other buildings outside the urban area'.

issues.detail: Grokbot lists several tab_items as requirements that are really process text or fee consequences: the 21-day 'WITHDRAWN' and administrative charge rule, 'The charge seeks to recover some of the cost of officer time', the 'validation dispute' Article 12 DMPO text, and 'it would be beneficial to upload any drawings with its full and detailed title'.
issues.evidence: Submission rules / Drawing standards tab_items.

issues.detail: Several tab_items are fragments of the SuDS pro-forma form or link text. Examples are 'Please list any relevant document and or drawing numbers ... Section 1. 38 ☐ ☐ SECTION 2 :' (and the Section 2 version), 'Methodology used to calculate peak runoff rate ... (Refer to Table 24.1 of The SuDS Manual)', which is cut off, and 'Mineral-Safeguarding-Areas-GuidanceNote_201505.pdf (lancashire.gov.uk) L34 Fire Statement Required:'. The Pre-application advice row is not a requirement either: L1 says 'Not required for validation'.
issues.evidence: Appendix G North West SuDS Pro-forma; L1 'Details of any Pre-application Discussions Not required for validation'.

issues.detail: 'Be drawn to a recognised metric scale, preferably 1:50 or 1:100' appears three times in Drawing / document standards. Two copies have unrelated text attached: the householder roof-plan exemption and 'N11 Design & Access Statement Required for'.
issues.evidence: N8/N9/N10 each repeat the scale wording.

issues.detail: The List date 2025-03-01 comes from the upload folder in the URL ('Date basis: url path'), not from the document. The checklist text carries no adoption date. Its content matches the 'Validation Checklist January 2024' revision put to the council's Planning and Highways Committee, which is the better date basis.
issues.evidence: Committee paper title 'Final Draft version - Validation Checklist January 2024'; the checklist body has no version or date.
issues.grok_comment: The Jan 2024 date is right, but the checklist itself does carry a date: its title page reads "VALIDATION CHECKLIST 1st January 2024", so the claim that the body has no date is wrong. The workbook date 2025-03-01 does come from the URL path.
issues.claude_response: Kept, with a correction. Grok confirms the 2025-03 date comes from the URL, while the document title page says 1 January 2024. The recorded date is wrong.

issues.detail: The reference row's 'Planning page' is just the council homepage (https://www.blackburn.gov.uk), not the planning application page that hosts the checklist.
issues.evidence: Search shows the council page 'Apply for planning permission' at blackburn.gov.uk/planning/planning-permission-applications/apply-planning-permission (also the documentation URL on planning.data.gov.uk).

summary: I could not fetch Grokbot's link or any blackburn.gov.uk page (robots_disallowed), so I could not confirm that the March 2025 upload is the file the council page links to now; no newer version turned up. Checked against the council's January 2024 checklist from its committee papers, Grokbot's extraction is poor: householder and every other application type are wrongly marked as having no local requirements, around eight local items are missing (Retail Impact, Refuse Storage, Vacant Building Credit, Met Office, Public Water Supply and others), and many triggers are cut off, swapped or boilerplate.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
